status: implementation choices specified before every new market GAS or neural fit
method_claim: Independent mathematical implementation of a published filter with declared carbon probability-task adaptations; not a novel model or full-paper numerical reproduction

filter.states: Student location m and scale-squared s2, not variance
filter.input_normalization: Use prior m_t,s2_t for x_t, then update with the actually observed x_t
filter.preprint_typographic_choice: Use beta_scale on the scale equation, as the author code does; preprint Eq4 prints beta_mean there
filter.future_prediction: Paper pure AR: m_next=omega_mean+beta_mean*m; s2_next=omega_scale+beta_scale*s2; no score evaluation at fabricated future x=m
filter.prediction_index: After consuming observed row t, saved state is for t+1; horizon h adds h-1 pure AR steps

static_fit.mature_training_prefix: Target maturities h through train_label_end inclusive; train_label_end=train_last_origin+20, strictly before validation first origin
static_fit.input_transform: Fit mean and population standard deviation on that same mature training prefix; hold fixed. This defines the units of the state-change penalty
static_fit.objective: For t=0..T-2, score the actual next observation under the updated Student prior, weighted by gamma_mean+gamma_scale; add .5*(1-gamma_mean)*(m_next-m)^2 + .5*(1-gamma_scale)*(s2_next-s2)^2; divide by T-1
static_fit.difference_from_author_code: Do not append a duplicate final observation. Use exactly T-1 genuine next targets. This is not claimed to reproduce the paper's general Fisher-matrix penalty verbatim
static_fit.optimizer_nonconvergence: Retain valid finite fitted parameters and disclose status, nfev and objective; never silently replace with Global Norm. Invalid state paths raise
static_fit.parameter_accounting: Eight static GAS parameters plus two fixed input affine moments; Global/EWMA each estimate two initialization moments. All arms have exactly the same number of neural parameters, not the same total number of fitted constants

other_normalizers.Global: Fixed mean and population standard deviation on the identical mature target-process training prefix
other_normalizers.EWMA: Initialize from the same train mean and variance. Normalize x using prior mean/variance; residual=x-old_mean; update mean=.94*old_mean+.06*x and variance=.94*old_variance+.06*residual^2
other_normalizers.EWMA_std_floor: 1e-4 times the training target-process standard deviation
other_normalizers.EWMA_future: Keep the last next-prior mean and variance for every future horizon; do not apply a fake zero-residual update

neural_head.backbone: GRU input1 hidden16 layers1, last hidden state; Linear16->9
neural_head.history: 20 already-mature observations of x_t^h; same process and window in every arm
neural_head.sigmas0: (.5,1,2) divided by sqrt(sum(weights0*(.5,1,2)^2)), hence unit mixture variance
neural_head.raw_head_initialization: Head weight and bias are exactly zero. The GRU initialization is matched across normalizers within seed
neural_head.final_density: Gaussian mixture in log return, lognormal mixture in price; Student is the working filter only
neural_head.epoch0_precision: Evaluate raw neural outputs through the same float64 head transform as the no-neural control, preserving exact epoch0 ties

training.validation_selection: All 40 epochs and epoch0; smallest normalized CRPS, retain earliest strict improvement
training.batch_order: Within each seed and epoch, identical permutation across normalizer arms
training.common_loss_unit: Return CRPS divided by origin causal daily-EWMA sigma*sqrt(h), identical across arms
training.prediction_and_scoring_float: float64 transformation of raw network outputs, analytic finite-mixture scores
training.train_loss_history: Pre-update minibatch losses averaged with sample weights along the changing epoch path; not a final-parameter full-train score

fixed_additional_controls.normalizer_without_neural_correction: Each of Global/EWMA/GAS with exactly the shared epoch0 three-Gaussian residual distribution
fixed_additional_controls.empirical_residual: For each normalizer use its mature training-origin h-step target residual divided by its issued h-step forecast std; 101 midpoint quantiles (j+.5)/101, numpy linear interpolation; keep empirical location, no recentering
fixed_additional_controls.empirical_forecast: Equal-mass 101-atom residual distribution, affine transform by each origin's issued filter stats; exact finite CRPS and price moments
fixed_additional_controls.empirical_NLL: Not defined as a continuous density score; omit NLL fields rather than invent a kernel bandwidth
fixed_additional_controls.common_daily_EWMA: Normalized N(0,1), equivalent to raw log-return variance equal to the common unit squared

execution.source_identity: Every stage requires the explicit previously frozen source fingerprint and saves START source hashes before reading/fitting
execution.private_records: All prepared targets/features, fitted normalization parameters, checkpoints, per-origin weights/means/sigmas/atoms, price transforms and scores
execution.public_records: Only source, protocols, formula audits, per-fit and per-cell aggregate metrics, validation histories, fit counters and runtime
execution.bootstrap: 1999 paired circular block resamples within each of 11 fixed panels, block40, same origins across h and models; nominal95% intervals
execution.incomplete_job_recovery: Per-job start receipts are saved; partial jobs are rejected on resume and require an explicitly recorded recovery, never silent refitting
